name: Zephyr Stable Dollar
oneLiner: ZSD is Zephyr Protocol's dollar stablecoin on a Monero-derived private chain, minted from ZEPH base-coin collateral through a Djed-inspired reserve mechanism.
collateral: ZEPH base-coin collateral held by the Zephyr Protocol reserve; the protocol targets overcollateralization before allowing new ZSD minting
pegMechanism: Users mint or redeem ZSD against ZEPH through Zephyr's Djed-inspired reserve mechanism, with oracle pricing and reserve-ratio constraints maintaining the dollar target

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Zephyr documentation presents ZSD as a native asset on a Monero-derived protocol and does not identify an issuer-controlled freeze, blacklist, pause, privileged burn, or proxy-upgrade control surface for holder balances.

mintAuthority.summary: ZSD is minted and redeemed through Zephyr's native reserve-ratio protocol rules against ZEPH collateral; no privileged issuer/admin mint path was resolved from official materials.

controls.label: Zephyr native reserve mint/redeem rules
controls.capDescription: Minting depends on native reserve-ratio and oracle rules described in the Zephyr whitepaper/source, not an EVM-style privileged minter.
controls.evidence: Official whitepaper/docs describe ZSD as minted/redeemed against ZEPH reserve mechanics with reserve-ratio constraints; local metadata links the official source repository and live reserve snapshot API.

review.evidence: No separate privileged mint authority was resolved for native ZSD beyond protocol conversion rules.
unresolvedQuestions: A protocol specialist should confirm no emergency hard-fork or foundation-operated mint bypass exists in current Zephyr code.

notices.title: Unsupported private chain
notices.message: ZSD primarily circulates as a native Zephyr asset on a Monero-derived chain, which is not a configured Pharos chain, so no contract is stored.
